subject: Unforeseen mechanical field condition: unforeseen ceiling height restriction affecting

messages.text: Our crew hit the unforeseen ceiling height restriction affecting the ductwork routing at EF-4 and need your call on the permanent fix. We would like this resolved ahead of the next work sequence. There will be a cost impact to address this condition. This is not holding up other work currently. A response Friday would be appreciated.
Reroute to clear the conflict at EF-4 per the attached sketch; proceed once you've confirmed clearance. There will be a cost impact to address this condition.
